summary: Phase 31 — Claros AI (VEDA rebrand) end-to-end testing. Backend 11/11 tests PASS (new session manager endpoints + content source delete + role gating 403s + assistant integration + regression). Frontend /ai chat UI and /ai/knowledge KB manager fully functional: all data-testid hooks present, 4 suggested starters, AI reply contains attendance/75%, Ctrl+Enter shortcut works, char counter live, New Chat resets, sessions persist + appear on top with truncated title. KB page renders eyebrow, dropzone, 7 source-type options (Syllabus/Policy/FAQ/Research/Placement/Regulation/General), 3 seeded indexed docs in table. Brand sweep clean across /dashboard, /settings, /admin-guide, /onboarding, /ai-instructor, /exec-briefing, /student-assistant, /veda-console (zero 'AcademiaOS' in body, 'Claros' everywhere). One blocker discovered & SELF-FIXED: served document <title> remained 'AcademiaOS · Unified Academic Intelligence' because the CRA dev-server had cached the previous public/index.html in memory — `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` flushed it and the title now correctly reads 'Claros · Unified Academic Intelligence'.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_ai.py session-manager endpoints (list/detail/delete/new) follow consistent ownership-check pattern: cross-user 403 unless super_admin. Verified via test_session_detail_cross_user_403 + test_session_detail_super_admin_ok.

delete_source correctly cascades: deletes content_chunks first, then content_sources, then best-effort os.remove of the on-disk file, and writes an audit_log row. Role gate covers super_admin/institution_admin/faculty/instructor/registrar/programme_manager/compliance_officer/ai_governance_admin — broader than the review-request spec but still excludes students.
list_user_sessions limits to 50 latest and derives title from the first user message (≤60 chars then ellipsis). Good UX, no _id leakage (find projection {'_id':0}).
Assistant system prompt rebrand to 'Claros AI' is fully transparent — no functional regression observed in instructor/assistant flows.

Front-end: ClarosAI.jsx Ctrl+Enter handler works, char-counter is reactive, New Chat correctly resets local state without an extra network call. ClarosKnowledge.jsx uploads to /ai/content/upload then chains to /veda/{iid}/kb/ingest-run (chunk+index).

DOC-TITLE STALENESS: /app/frontend/public/index.html had the right title, but the served HTML was outdated. CRA dev server caches index.html in-memory on startup. This is fragile — any edit to public/index.html silently keeps the old title until a frontend restart. Recommend a brief note in PRD/deploy doc, OR a small tweak to mark CRA's WDS to watch public/index.html (it does not by default).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-31 Claros AI rebrand + 2 new pages + 5 new endpoints fully verified. Login → /ai → click suggested 'What is the attendance policy?' → AI replies with 75% policy text from VCE seed RAG. /ai/knowledge → 3 seeded VCE docs in the table, source-type dropdown shows 7 enum values. To replay backend smoke run: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase31_claros_ai.py -v`. rca_of_the_issue: Brand title staleness RCA: react-scripts (CRA) reads public/index.html once at dev-server start and serves it from memory; subsequent edits to public/index.html do NOT auto-reload that page template (only src/ changes trigger HMR). The rebrand main-agent edit was made to public/index.html but no supervisor restart followed, so the preview URL continued returning the old title. Resolution: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`; preview now returns correct <title>. Recommended mitigation: instruct the main agent to restart frontend supervisor whenever public/index.html is edited, OR move the dynamic title into a Helmet/React-Helmet component driven by i18n.
